findings.description: utc_day does not convert to UTC before extracting the date, returning the local date instead of the UTC calendar date.
findings.evidence: For input '2024-01-01T01:00:00+02:00', datetime.fromisoformat returns a datetime with UTC offset +02:00. .date() then yields 2024-01-01, but the equivalent UTC time is 2023-12-31T23:00:00Z, so the correct UTC date is 2023-12-31. The function incorrectly returns 2024-01-01, demonstrating a contract violation.

review.summary: Candidate implementation fails to convert timestamps to UTC before extracting the date, violating the contract when the offset causes the UTC date to differ from the local date.
